title: How a Teen Turned a Simple Warning into Felony Arrest
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On March 16, 2024, an officer attempted to stop a speeding motorcycle in Holmen, WI. During the chase, speeds exceeded 90 mph. Ahead of the pursuit was a La Crosse County Sheriff’s deputy handling an unrelated vehicle accident. The motorcyclist, seeing the deputy, likely thought it was another officer preparing to deploy spike strips and decided to stop and surrender.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
